results.title: HS Code for Car Floor Mats Update September 2026
results.content: The full 6-digit HS Code for Car Floor Mats is 5703.20, where Chapter 57 represents 'Carpets and other textile floor coverings,' Heading 03 denotes 'Carpets and other textile floor coverings, tufted,' and Subheading 20 refers specifically to 'Other carpets and other textile floor coverings, tufted.' This product falls under this specific code due to its nature as a textile floor covering designed for use in vehicles. Trade considerations for Car Floor Mats include packaging them in plastic [...] Product Overview Car Floor Mats under HS Code 5703 are precisely defined as textile floor coverings that are used inside automobiles to protect the vehicle's interior flooring. These mats, manufactured from hard-wearing materials such as rubber, polyvinyl chloride (PVC), or textile fabric, are designed to withstand heavy wear and tear while providing comfort and cleanliness. They are typically categorized into two subcategories: universal mats, suitable for use in any car model, and custom or [...] and custom or tailored mats, specifically designed to fit individual car models. Car Floor Mats offer commercial applications across various sectors, including automobile manufacturing, retail, aftermarket auto-parts, and car rental services. Their key value proposition lies in their durability, ease of maintenance, and their capability to enhance the vehicle's interior aesthetics while protecting against dirt, spills, and wear.
